newsitem.title: USA: PS New Mexico 361 MW coal unit seen up Fri.
newsitem.headline: PS New Mexico 361 MW coal unit seen up Fri.

text.p: The 361 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at the San Juan coal-fired power plant in New Mexico should be back in service sometime Friday, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Thursday.
The San Juan plant is operated by Public Service Co of New Mexico.
The unit was taken off line Wednesday afternoon for repairs to boiler tubes, the sources said.
San Juan's other three units, one with a capacity of 350 MW and two at 540 MW, are said to be operating normally.
